summary.default: Translates mail and selected text, with nothing to set up. The text goes to a third-party translation service through an unofficial interface, which may be rate limited or stop working.
summary.zh-Hans: 翻译邮件与选中文本，无需设置。文本会通过非官方接口发送到第三方翻译服务，可能被限流或失效。

summary.default: Local judge models: label mail and answer yes/no questions on this computer, with no mail sent anywhere. Downloads a 2–2.7 GB model when you choose it; on computers without Apple silicon it is slow and best for new mail only.
summary.zh-Hans: 本地判断模型：在本机给邮件打标签、回答是非题，邮件内容不发往任何地方。选用时下载 2–2.7 GB 的模型；非 Apple 芯片的电脑上较慢，建议只给新邮件打标签。

summary.default: Use Gemini through your Google Antigravity sign-in. Unofficial and against Antigravity's terms, which forbid third-party access: Google may suspend your Antigravity and Gemini CLI access. Mail you send to these models goes to Google, which stores it and whose reviewers may read it. macOS only; downloads Google's server (about 100 MB) when you sign in. A Gemini API key under Models is the supported way.
summary.zh-Hans: 用 Google Antigravity 登录使用 Gemini。非官方，违反 Antigravity 条款（条款禁止第三方访问），Google 可能暂停你的 Antigravity 和 Gemini CLI 使用权。发给这些模型的邮件会发往 Google，由其存储，审核人员可能查看。仅限 macOS，登录时下载 Google 的服务程序（约 100 MB）。受支持的做法是在模型设置里使用 Gemini API key。
